jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /posting-api/job-board/{boardName}/jobs.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated POST /candidate.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, and createdAfter filters.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated POST /application.list. Optional limit, cursor, syncToken, createdAfter, status, and jobId filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated POST /candidate.info. Requires id or externalMappingId.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Fetch a single application via authenticated POST /application.info. Requires applicationId or submittedFormInstanceId.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates
candidates.search.description: Search candidates by email and/or name via authenticated POST /candidate.search. Requires email or name (AND-combined when both set). Not paginated; responses capped by Ashby (~100).

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interview definitions via authenticated POST /interview.list. Optional limit, cursor, and syncToken filters.
